name: mod-blast-radius
description: Holds a risky Bash command (rm, git reset --hard, force push, SQL DROP and more) before it runs, shows what it would change, and lets you Run or Cancel

enabled.title: Hold risky commands
enabled.description: On, a risky Bash command waits for your Run or Cancel. Off, every command runs as usual

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto uses Nerd Font icons when Windows Terminal runs a Nerd Font, and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one
